name: fetchfido
description: Security hardened Go web service for Podman/Kubernetes learning

scripts.dev: npm run container:stop || true && npm run container:clean && npm run container:build && npm run container:run
scripts.container:run-tls: podman run --rm -p 8080:8080 -p 9998:9998/udp -v ./certs:/certs:ro -e TLS_CERT_FILE=/certs/fullchain.pem -e TLS_KEY_FILE=/certs/privkey.pem --name fetchfido fetchfido:latest
scripts.container:run-tls-detached: podman run -d -p 8080:8080 -p 9998:9998/udp -v ./certs:/certs:ro -e TLS_CERT_FILE=/certs/fullchain.pem -e TLS_KEY_FILE=/certs/privkey.pem --name fetchfido fetchfido:latest
